title: Gold Mini Lot Size on MCX: Gold Contract Sizes Compared
summary: MCX Gold Mini lot size is 100 grams. Compare Gold (1 kg), Gold Ten (10 g), Gold Guinea (8 g) and Gold Petal (1 g) by lot value, P&L per ₹1 move and expiry.
body_markdown:
The MCX Gold Mini lot size is 100 grams, which is the fixed quantity of gold in one Gold Mini contract. MCX has four other gold futures contracts, from 1 kg down to 1 gram, so traders with very different budgets can trade the same gold price.


**Quick answer: MCX gold lot size**


-


One lot of Gold Mini (GOLDM) is 100 grams.


-


One lot of Gold (GOLD) is 1 kg.


-


One lot of Gold Ten (GOLDTEN) is 10 grams.


-


One lot of Gold Guinea (GOLDGUINEA) is 8 grams.


-


One lot of Gold Petal (GOLDPETAL) is 1 gram, the smallest gold contract on MCX.


-


Gold, Gold Mini and Gold Ten are quoted per 10 grams, so a ₹1 move changes one futures lot by ₹100, ₹10 and ₹1.

## Gold Mini Lot Size (GOLDM)


The Gold Mini lot size is 100 grams. It is quoted per 10 grams, so one lot holds 10 quote units, and a ₹1 move changes one futures lot by ₹10.


Ten Gold Mini lots equal one standard Gold lot. Gold Mini contracts are listed every month and expire on the 5th. Gold Mini options, launched in April 2022, use the same 100 gram lot.


### Gold Lot Size (GOLD)


The standard MCX Gold lot size is 1 kg. It is quoted per 10 grams, so one lot holds 100 quote units, and a ₹1 move changes one futures lot by ₹100.


Gold futures are listed every second month (February, April, June, August, October and December) and expire on the 5th. Gold options are monthly and use the same 1 kg lot.


### Gold Ten, Gold Guinea and Gold Petal Lot Size


MCX’s three smallest gold contracts trade as futures only. All three expire on the last calendar day of each month.


#### Gold Ten Lot Size (GOLDTEN)


The Gold Ten lot size is 10 grams. MCX launched it on April 1, 2025. It is quoted per 10 grams, so a ₹1 move changes one lot by ₹1, and 10 Gold Ten lots equal one Gold Mini lot.


#### Gold Guinea Lot Size (GOLDGUINEA)


The Gold Guinea lot size is 8 grams. It is quoted per 8 grams, so a ₹1 move in the quoted price changes one lot by ₹1.


#### Gold Petal Lot Size (GOLDPETAL)


The Gold Petal lot size is 1 gram, the smallest on MCX. It is quoted per gram, so a ₹1 move changes one lot by ₹1.


## How to Calculate the Value of 1 Lot of Gold


Work out how many quote units fit in one lot, then multiply by the price.


-


Gold Mini holds 10 units of 10 grams. At ₹1,40,000 per 10 grams, one lot is worth ₹14,00,000.


-


Gold holds 100 units of 10 grams, so one lot is worth ₹1,40,00,000 at the same price.


-


If gold rises by ₹100 per 10 grams across all contracts, a long futures lot gains ₹10,000 on Gold, ₹1,000 on Gold Mini, ₹100 on Gold Ten, ₹80 on Gold Guinea and ₹10 on Gold Petal. The same fall causes the same loss.


Contract value is not the money you pay. Here is what each amount means:

Futures margin

## Which Gold Lot Size Fits You?


-


Gold Petal, Gold Guinea and Gold Ten need the least capital, but they trade as futures only.


-


Gold Mini is the smallest gold contract with options, so it suits option traders who want less exposure than standard Gold.


-


Standard Gold suits large accounts that are comfortable with a ₹100 change in P&L for every ₹1 move.


-


The smallest contracts can trade with less volume, so check[liquidity](https://algotest.in/blog/what-is-liquidity-in-trading/) and the bid-ask spread before you place an order.


Pick the size that keeps your loss on one trade within a fixed limit. Our guide to[trading risk management rules](https://algotest.in/blog/trading-risk-management-rules-examples-and-a-practical-plan/) shows how to set that limit.


## MCX Gold Options Lot Size


MCX offers options on Gold and Gold Mini. One Gold option lot covers 1 kg, and one Gold Mini option lot covers 100 grams, the same as their underlying futures. Gold Ten, Gold Guinea and Gold Petal have no options.


-


Option premiums are quoted per 10 grams. If a Gold Mini call trades at ₹1,000 per 10 grams, one lot costs ₹1,000 × 10 = ₹10,000, and a Gold call at the same premium costs ₹1,00,000. Our[option premium calculator](https://algotest.in/blog/option-premium-calculator/) guide explains what drives that price.


-


Option P&L follows the change in the premium, not the gold price one to one, so a ₹1 move in gold does not change an option lot by the futures amounts in the table.


-


Gold options are monthly and expire before their underlying futures. Gold Mini options expire three business days before the underlying futures enter their tender period, so[pick your expiry](https://algotest.in/blog/stay-informed-choosing-right-expiry-date-options/) with that date in mind.


-


In-the-money options held to expiry are normally exercised and turn into futures at the strike price, unless a contrary instruction is given through your broker. Those futures then carry delivery obligations.


-


Option sellers need margin, and buyers may need extra funds near expiry if their positions turn into futures.

## Gold Expiry and Delivery on MCX


-


Gold and Gold Mini futures expire on the 5th of their expiry month, or the working day before if the 5th is a holiday or weekend.


-


Gold Ten, Gold Guinea and Gold Petal futures expire on the last calendar day of each month, with the same holiday rule.


-


Open gold futures positions held through expiry are subject to compulsory delivery.


-


All five contracts have a tender period before expiry, when delivery can be assigned. For Gold Ten, Gold Guinea and Gold Petal, it covers the last three trading days, including expiry day.


-


If you do not want physical gold, exit before the tender period starts. Many brokers close positions early, so check your broker’s cutoff.


Gold trades from 9:00 AM to 11:30 PM or 11:55 PM, so the evening session overlaps with[US market hours](https://algotest.in/blog/us-market-opening-time-in-india/) , when US data releases can move gold prices sharply.

### FAQs


#### What is the gold mini lot size?


The Gold Mini lot size on MCX is 100 grams. It is quoted per 10 grams, so a ₹1 move changes one futures lot by ₹10.


#### Is the Gold Mini lot size 100 or 10?


The lot size is 100 grams. The number 10 comes from the price quote: Gold Mini is quoted per 10 grams, so one lot holds 10 quote units.


#### What is the Gold Mini tick value?


The Gold Mini futures tick is ₹1 per 10 grams, which is worth ₹10 per lot. The Gold Mini options premium tick is ₹0.50 per 10 grams, which is worth ₹5 per lot.


#### How much money do I need to trade one Gold Mini lot?


For futures, you need the margin, not the full contract value. At ₹1,40,000 per 10 grams, one lot is worth ₹14,00,000, but your broker blocks only a share of that as margin. Check the estimated margin in the[AlgoTest margin calculator](https://algotest.in/margin-calculator) and confirm it with your broker. An option buyer pays only the premium, such as ₹10,000 for a call priced at ₹1,000 per 10 grams.


#### How much is 1 lot of gold in MCX?


One lot of standard MCX Gold is 1 kg. Gold Mini is 100 grams, Gold Ten is 10 grams, Gold Guinea is 8 grams and Gold Petal is 1 gram.


#### What is the smallest gold contract on MCX?


Gold Petal, with a lot size of 1 gram. It is quoted per gram and trades as futures only.


#### What is the Gold Ten lot size?


The Gold Ten lot size is 10 grams. MCX launched it on April 1, 2025, and it is quoted per 10 grams.


#### What is the Gold Guinea lot size?


The Gold Guinea lot size is 8 grams. It is quoted per 8 grams and expires on the last calendar day of each month.


#### When does Gold Mini expire?


Gold Mini futures expire on the 5th of every month, or the working day before if the 5th is a holiday or weekend.


#### Is MCX gold physically delivered?


Yes. Open gold futures positions held through expiry are subject to compulsory delivery, so exit before the tender period if you do not want physical gold.
